skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals a 2-hit combo of 60% ATK to a single target, and grants self [Tenacity] (absorbs damage equal to 30% of own HP).

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals damage to a single target equal to 45% of Pig God's max HP, and [Devours] the target, forcing it out of combat for 1 turn (triggers once per turn).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals damage to a single target equal to 60% of Pig God's max HP, and [Devours] the target, forcing it out of combat for 1 turn (triggers once per turn).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. Gains 15% Non-Crit DMG Immunity (reduces all types of damage; only one of this and [Dexterity] takes effect), and is immune to [Out of Combat] and [Devour Out of Combat].

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. Gains 20% Non-Crit DMG Immunity (reduces all types of damage; only one of this and [Dexterity] takes effect), and is immune to [Out of Combat] and [Devour Out of Combat].

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. Gains 25% Non-Crit DMG Immunity (reduces all types of damage; only one of this and [Dexterity] takes effect), and is immune to [Out of Combat] and [Devour Out of Combat].

effects.desc: The shield absorbs damage over time and damage types (Damage, Internal Damage, Charge).
